crossRefs.note: Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Obed-Edom, a gatekeeper in David's time.

people.name: Peullethai
people.line: Son of Obed-Edom, a temple gatekeeper

translations.web: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
translations.bsb: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth. For God had blessed Obed-edom.
translations.kjv: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
translations.asv: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
